Name: Yukis' More Mature Sam
Author: ghingerbread
Description:
[size=2][b]300+ lines of new daily dialogue[/b] across five relationship stages, each written to reflect exactly where Sam is with you:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Low hearts (stranger)[/b] - He's polite but guarded. You get surface level Sam.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Mid hearts (curious)[/b] - He's starting to wonder about you. He asks questions. He lets things slip.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]High hearts (himself)[/b] - The walls are down. This is who he actually is.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Romance (unguarded)[/b] - The boyish charm comes back naturally because he's not trying to manage how he comes across.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][b]Marriage (settled)[/b] - Comfortable in the best way. [/size][/*]
[/list][size=2][b]
Full rain dialogue rewrite[/b] - generic rain lines plus Monday and Friday variants.

[b]All heart events rewritten[/b] - the jam session, the beach with Vincent, the egg in the kitchen, the skateboard confrontation with Lewis, the Zuzu City show, and the bedroom confession. Every scene has been reworked so his reactions feel like a real adult's.

[b]All eight festival dialogues rewritten[/b] - he still has allergies at the Flower Dance. He still loses all his tokens at the Fair. It's still him just catered to us who want a more mature feel to our favorite boy.

[b]Optional add-on - [/b]A separate schedule mod is included if you want Sam working full time at JojaMart Sun–Thu with Fridays and Saturdays off. Standalone - use it or don't. He's a man with a full time job to help support his mother. 

[b]Design philosophy -  [/b]Nothing about Sam's core personality was changed. The goal was never to make him brooding or serious - it was to give him the kind of emotional range that makes you actually believe he's a person. The heart events in particular were rewritten with one question in mind: [i]what would a 28-year-old actually do here?[/i]
[b]
A note - [/b]This started because I am a 28 year old woman who is tired of my favorite romance behaving like a 18 year old boy, I wanted a more mature version of him. And in the future I plan to do the same for Abigail and Seb. 
[/size][size=2]
[b]Compatibility:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Mods that add dialogue to Sam [b][u]ARE[/u][/b] compatible though you will have a mismatched young/mature vibe. [/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Mods that change Sam's EVENTS are [u][b]SOMEWHAT[/b][/u] compatible, it will take over my mod since these events are just vanilla events rewritten, but you will still get his normal dialogue, again just with that young/mature mismatch.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=2]
[b]Bugs[/b] - Please report all bugs you come across, including spelling errors. 

[b]Portrait Mod & Sprite: [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12115]Sam Revised Hair Portrait[/url] - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21864]Seasonal & Sam Revised Hair Add-Ons[/url][/size]
